quote.text: Sick and yet happy, in peril and yet happy, dying and yet happy, in exile and happy, in disgrace and happy.
quote.author: Epictetus
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Recognize that just as one finds happiness even in suffering, the challenges of parenthood carry profound opportunities to grow alongside one’s children.
    • Embrace the trials—be it exhaustion or moments of doubt—as moments that refine your character and deepen the bond of care and understanding with your family.
  • Leadership
    • Just as Epictetus teaches that one can be happy amidst danger and disgrace, true leadership means finding inner peace even in turbulent times, guiding others with steady resolve.
    • Use adversity as a lesson; each struggle encountered in leadership reveals strengths and encourages a compassionate, resilient approach to serving your team.
  • Product Management
    • Adopt the mindset that challenges—be they setbacks in development or market uncertainties—are inherent to innovation and should be met with gratitude for the learning they provide.
    • Find contentment in the process, knowing that each difficulty is an opportunity to refine your vision, nurture creative solutions, and build something enduring.
